fixes.explanation: Finest speaker in Egypt would be quite the upgrade, but that's a bigger promise than the one the LORD makes. He says, “I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say.” (Exodus 4:12) Moses still does the speaking, with help and teaching. Honestly, I'd take that deal. My whole speech career was one long stretch of staying quiet in the back of a junk drawer.

problems.problem: Papa says the only thing anyone ever taught him was how to press a stamp straight, but the angel taught him about God and the Marriage Supper in his backstory.
